bagPolicy.summary: Bryce Jordan Center's current concert guidance permits clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, and clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 x 1 inch. Non-approved bags must be returned to the vehicle because the venue has no prohibited-item check-in.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
Small clutch up to 4.5 x 6.5 x 1 inch
Diaper bag with accompanying infant after inspection
prohibited: Clear bags larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Event parking is available in Jordan East, Stadium West, and Porter North commuter lots. Cash is not accepted on event nights; guests may prepay through ParkWhiz by the day before the event or pay the full day-of rate through HONK.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Rideshare vehicles may pick up and drop off within the Stadium West, Jordan East, and Porter North parking lots.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The reviewed official concert page confirms that Bryce Jordan Center concession locations accept cashless payment beginning September 2, 2026 and that alcohol is available for that event with valid ID for guests 21 and older. It does not publish a universal food-vendor list for all events.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is available through the Bryce Jordan Center Box Office and Ticketmaster, and the venue recommends contacting the ticket office directly for seating needs. Its official concert page also links to accommodations for interpreting, wheelchair spaces, and guide animals.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The reviewed official Bryce Jordan Center concert page does not state a specific re-entry policy.

ticketPickup.summary: The Bryce Jordan Center Ticket Office is between Gates A and B and opens at door time on event days, remaining open until about one hour after the event begins. The reviewed ticket page emphasizes mobile tickets and does not state one universal will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Door and gate details vary by event; the reviewed official concert listing for Alabama on October 9, 2026 specifies doors at 6:00 PM for a 7:00 PM show and lists all gates. The venue does not publish that timing as a universal rule for every concert.
